items.name: GAN WCA Oceanic Championship FMC 2026
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjI4MDMyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2cde4839fc69270c03198a1ceca1b5caef35729f/1000018149.png)

**This is the FMC-only part of [GAN WCA Oceanic Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OC2026)**. As FMC will not be held at the main competition, this is your chance to compete for the 2026 Oceanic FMC Champion title. Podium finishers will be recognised during the main awards ceremony in Auckland, if they are present.

The competition will be held in multiple locations, across New Zealand and Australia. Please pay attention to the **schedule and time zone** of your location.
